about: A mesh box 10 mm a side, each side an 8 × 8 grid of triangle pairs (768 triangles, six regions), decimated as far as it goes: its 12 triangles, the corners and creases exact (the regions' boundaries kept), the faces keeping their names.
oracle: Closed form: any decimation that keeps the regions' boundaries (the box's creases) and its corners leaves the box itself, two triangles a side.
